title: Order of De De's bands: Celestin, then Paul Barnes
summary: De De places his time with Celestin well before the Depression and his joining Paul Barnes after; they recall meeting Barnes recently.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: I wondered when you were with Celestan. Do you remember what band you were with before you went with Celestan? Or were you Spartan or what?
Mostly Spartan like that, when you get together.
Let's see, that would be, was that before Depression or after or what?
Oh, maybe way before Depression, I imagine.
Way before Depression when you were with Celestan. Oh yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. Was it before you were with Paul Barnes?

Yeah, with Celestan, yeah, I imagine so, yeah, yeah. And I joined Paul after. I saw him the other day. Paul? Yeah, they won a, what was that Billy? They played? We met Paul. I was with you. Oh, that's right you were, that's right you were, yeah, yeah.
It was a Sunday after Depression.
I hadn't seen him in a long time. Yeah, you remember when I was?
Yeah, we had a good time. I wanted to see him, yeah, yeah, I enjoyed it. I enjoyed it.
I was really there. He was supposed to visit me out of the way. He came here, yeah. Oh, my old buddy.
